text: This is the main architecture doc. The system uses a layered architecture. See Database Design for the data layer. Also related to API Specification.
PostgreSQL schema with full-text search is used for the data layer. No outgoing links from here.
REST endpoints for the billing service are documented here. See Architecture Overview and Database Design for context.
Users can redeem a coupon code against an order at checkout. This is the coupon redeem feature overview.
A coupon has an expiry date after which it can no longer be redeemed. This describes the coupon expiry feature.
Test cases for coupon redemption: valid coupon applies discount, expired coupon is rejected, invalid code is rejected.
We use PostgreSQL as our database with full text search enabled for the data layer, exactly the same as described in the architecture.
The coupon redemption feature lets a user apply a coupon code to their order during checkout, same as before.
